bio: In the midst of Soho and moments from Mayfair, Ham Yard Hotel has an urban village feel. The hotel revolves around a tree-filled garden with a bronze sculpture centrepiece by Tony Cragg.  Served in both the contemporary restaurant and chic drawing room, Ham Yard Hotel is a stylish and glamourous place to have Afternoon Tea. Guests can choose from both Afternoon Tea sweet and savouries complimented by a variety of teas, with the option to add a classic cocktail, if you're in an especially indulgent mood.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
